meta.title: RoamView chassis, Rev B layout 2
meta.frame: +X forward, +Y up, +Z robot right; origin on the floor under the drive-axle centre (ROS base_footprint)

props.Notes: 6061-T6 plate, 320 x 260 x 6 mm. Rev B: wells lengthened to 150 mm for the 125 mm wheels, spring holes, 3-inch caster pattern, new pass-throughs and mounting holes
6061-T6 plate, 320 x 260 x 3 mm. Rev B: new pass-throughs, hanging power blocks, handle and e-stop holes
2020 aluminium extrusion, 120 mm
125 x 30 mm drive wheel on a 6 mm D-shaft hub (placeholder: pick a wheel with a hub for the 37D shaft). Rev B: was 100 x 26 mm

37 mm gearmotor with 64 CPR encoder (placeholder, recheck torque: 125 mm wheels need about 25 % more) bolted to a 5 mm aluminium module plate. The plate is the trailing arm: it pivots 66 mm behind the axle and its front tab carries the spring. 10 ...

37 mm gearmotor with 64 CPR encoder (placeholder, recheck torque: 125 mm wheels need about 25 % more) bolted to a 5 mm aluminium module plate. The plate is the trailing arm: it pivots 66 mm behind the axle and its front tab carries the spring. 10 ...
Aluminium hanger bolted under the lower deck (2 x M4); 8 mm shoulder-bolt pivot with bronze bushings
Aluminium hanger bolted under the lower deck (2 x M4); 8 mm shoulder-bolt pivot with bronze bushings

Compression spring (about 43 mm installed, 16 mm OD) on an M5 guide bolt. It pushes the module tab down through an 18 mm hole in the lower deck and seats in a cup on the deck top; the nut on the bolt is the droop stop. Rate and preload to set afte...
Low-profile 3-inch swivel plate caster, about 89 mm tall (3-1/2 in class), on a 4 mm spacer: mount face 93 mm. Placeholder until a caster is chosen. Rev B: was a 2-inch caster at X +-130
Low-profile 3-inch swivel plate caster, about 89 mm tall (3-1/2 in class), on a 4 mm spacer: mount face 93 mm. Placeholder until a caster is chosen. Rev B: was a 2-inch caster at X +-130
3 mm printed or aluminium tray on four M3 screws: rear stop and a 6 mm front lip hold the pack against 3 g

14.8 V nominal, about 7 Ah, pre-built pack with protection board and thermistor. 90 x 75 x 42 mm, in a tray with a rear stop and a 6 mm front lip, held by two straps. To remove: unplug the XT60, undo the straps, lift over the lip and slide it out ...

Perma-Proto half-size board (81 x 51 mm) on nylon standoffs: main fuse F1 (15 A) and branch fuses F3/F4 (3 A) in PCB blade holders, K1 motor relay with its 15 ohm coil resistor and flyback parts, and INA260 #1 on the motor rail. Every path over 3 ...

Two WAGO 221-415 lever splices in a screw-down carrier. Pack node +: pack, dock charge input and the feed to F1. Star ground: pack return, power-board ground, dock return and the frame-bond lug (the only frame connection)
Pack disconnect, riding on the pack's rear end on its own lead. Unplug it first; the pack half leaves with the pack
DFRobot DFR0601 dual-channel driver, 12 A per channel, 6.5-37 V, 50 x 50 x 12.5 mm. Control: PWM, INA, INB per channel from the ESP32
D1 (Pololu 5382 ideal diode, 10 A) and F2 (5 A ATO in an inline holder) on the + contact lead: the pack can never back-feed the exposed contacts
Brass L-contact on two M4 holes with an insulating washer. Face 62-99 mm above the floor, 3 mm behind the bumper face; the dock's spring pins reach it through the bumper window
Brass L-contact on two M4 holes with an insulating washer. Face 62-99 mm above the floor, 3 mm behind the bumper face; the dock's spring pins reach it through the bumper window

5 mm PETG bumper face 250 mm wide, 56-100 mm above the floor, on two flexure brackets under the lower deck, each clamped by its corner post's M5 bolt plus one M4 screw. Two Omron SS-5GL2 switches close when it moves 2 mm. Windows let the dock's pi...
Adafruit VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (25.5 x 17.7 mm) hanging under the lower deck, looking straight down at the floor 87 mm below. I2C at 3.3 V with its own XSHUT line
Inline Molex Micro-Fit 3.0 (2 x 3), tied to the rear-left post: compute feed, sensor feed and e-stop loop. Unplug it to lift the top deck

Inline Molex Micro-Fit 3.0 (2 x 12), tied to the rear-right post: encoders, driver control, I2C, 3.3 V and 5 V, cliff-sensor XSHUT lines, bumper switches. Unplug it to lift the top deck. Rev B: 24 pins (was 20)
3D-printed riser 50 x 50 x 40 mm, PETG 40 % infill, through-bolted, 12 mm cable bore on its axis. Rev B: 40 mm tall (was 60) so the scan plane stays near 286 mm
D500 DTOF LiDAR: 360 deg, 0.03-12 m, 10 Hz, UART 230400. Scan plane about 286 mm above the floor
Stereo depth + 12 MP colour, IMU, IR projector. USB-C on its back face
22 mm latching mushroom e-stop with two NC blocks: NC1 opens K1's coil, NC2 reports to the ESP32. Rev B: moved to X -105 so the handle and the Pi's ports stay clear of it
Raspberry Pi 5 on 6 mm nylon standoffs, turned so the USB/Ethernet ports face the rear edge, the USB-C power and micro-HDMI ports face the left edge, and the SD card faces forward
Adafruit Perma-Proto HAT on an extra-tall stacking header, with a 35 mm hole over the cooler fan. Locking JST-XH headers for UART0 (ESP32 link), UART2 (LiDAR) and the recording light

ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1-N32R16V in sockets on a Perma-Proto carrier at the top deck's rear-right. Its two USB-C ports face the rear edge so a laptop plugs in with the robot assembled. The carrier holds the 74LVC244 that shifts the 5 V encoder signals a...
2.4 GHz receiver with failsafe (47 x 26 x 15 mm, placeholder). Antennas vertical, tips below the LiDAR band
Luxonis USB-C Y-adapter: camera port faces right, host port faces the rear, power port faces left
Proposed replacement for the Anker S330, which is 120 mm across and does not fit: a 70 mm USB 4-mic array with echo cancellation (e.g. Seeed ReSpeaker USB Mic Array v2.0). Team decision
Small USB-powered speaker for two-way audio (placeholder). Team decision together with the mic array
16 mm panel indicator, lit whenever video or audio leaves the robot
16 mm panel indicator driven by the ESP32: ready, moving, fault, e-stop
16 mm grip across the rear, 38 mm above the top deck, bolted through the deck into the rear posts so the load goes into the frame. Top at 268 mm, below the LiDAR band. Lift here, never by the LiDAR

Hangs under the top deck: INA260 #2, ideal diode D2 and the 4700 uF hold-up capacitor on Buck A's 14.8 V input (about 30 ms of Pi power through a motor-inrush sag), then Buck A (Pololu D36V50F5) to 5.1 V for the Pi
Hangs under the top deck: INA260 #3 and Buck B (Pololu D36V50F5) to 5 V for the OAK-D, LiDAR, ESP32 side, encoders and RC relay

Pololu RC switch with relay (#2804) hanging under the top deck. Its contact sits in series with the e-stop NC1 in K1's coil loop, so losing the radio link or flipping the transmitter switch stops the motors. Its OUT pin (5 V) reports the relay sta...
Splits the LiDAR's 4-wire lead: TX to the Pi, 5 V and ground to Buck B
